consent.title: Data Sharing Consent
consent.description: As the authorized representative of {organization}, I acknowledge and agree that:
consent.bodyParagraph1: Data entered into the Development Needs Observatory platform — including studies, need records, survey responses, and supporting documents — will be stored on the platform and made accessible to the National Center for Non-Profit Sector Development (NCNP) for the purposes of rural development planning, needs prioritization, and program design.
consent.bodyParagraph2: NCNP may use aggregated and anonymized data derived from our organization's submissions in national reports, dashboards, and analyses. No individual-level personal data will be published.
consent.bodyParagraph3: Our organization remains responsible for the accuracy of the data it submits and for obtaining the permissions and consents required to collect and share it.
consent.bodyParagraph4: Data is processed in accordance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and stored within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
consent.bodyParagraph5: This consent remains in effect for as long as our organization uses the platform. Requests to withdraw consent or delete organizational data should be submitted to {contactChannel} and will be handled per the platform's data-governance procedures.

pn.notMeasured: Not measured — excluded from the ranking
pn.rankingBasis: Ranked by {basis}. The Priority Score column is that calculation's output for each need.
pn.locationScope: Location is the same for every row ({location}) because a need is measured as an indicator-level aggregate across the whole assessed scope, not attributed to one village. The full scope is given under Geographic Scope.
pn.affectedPopulationMissing: Affected population was not recorded for these needs, so every row shows a dash. It is asked for on the need-entry form and cannot be filled in afterwards for needs recorded before the question existed. The population figure under Response Quality is the study AREA's population — it sizes the sample and is not the number of people affected by any individual need.
pn.affectedPopulationScope: Affected population is the estimate given when the need was recorded, in answer to “roughly how many people does this need affect?”. It describes the need as a whole, so it repeats across that need’s indicator rows rather than varying by indicator. A dash means no estimate was given, not zero people.
